chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamdani (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us. He said: Ja'far ibn Salama al-Ahwazi narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abdallah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Hammam narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Jamil al-Raqqi narrated to us. He said: Layth narrated to us, from Mujahid, from Abdallah ibn Abbas. He said:

We were sitting in a gathering of the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was among us. We saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) pointing with his gaze toward the sky. So we looked, and we saw a cloud approaching. He said to it: 'Come forth.' So it came forth. Then he said to it: 'Come forth.' So it came forth. Then he said to it: 'Come forth.' So it came forth.

Then we saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) standing upright on his feet, and he reached his hands into the cloud until the whiteness of the armpits of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) became visible to us. Then he extracted from that cloud a white vessel filled with fresh dates. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) ate from the vessel, and the vessel glorified [Allah] in the palm of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Then he passed it to Ali ibn Abi Talib. So Ali (peace be upon him) ate from the vessel, and the vessel glorified [Allah] in the palm of Ali (peace be upon him).

A man said: O Messenger of Allah! You ate from the vessel and then passed it to Ali ibn Abi Talib! Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, caused the vessel to speak, and it said: There is no god but Allah, Creator of darkness and light. Know, O people, that I am the gift of the Truthful to His Speaking Prophet. None eat from me except a prophet or a deputy of a prophet.

key_terms.الجام: vessel/bowl — a receptacle miraculously brought from a cloud
key_terms.الصادق: the Truthful — an attribute of Allah used here
key_terms.سبّح: glorified Allah, recited tasbih — referring to the bowl's miraculous glorification
key_terms.وصي: deputy/successor — the wasi of the Prophet, referring to Imam Ali (AS)

ai.seo_question: What miracle involving a cloud and a vessel of dates is narrated by Ibn Abbas in al-Amali al-Saduq?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a miraculous event witnessed by Abdallah ibn Abbas and the companions of the Prophet. The Prophet commanded a cloud to approach, then reached into it and drew out a white vessel filled with fresh dates. After he and Imam Ali (AS) ate from it and the vessel glorified Allah, it then spoke aloud to declare that only a prophet or a prophet's deputy (wasi) may eat from it — confirming the unique spiritual status of both the Prophet and Ali ibn Abi Talib. This account was transmitted through a long chain of narrators and was recorded by Sheikh al-Saduq in his Amali sessions of 368 AH.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Ziyad b. Ja`far al-Hamadani (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Hammam narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Jamil al-Raqqi narrated to us. He said: Layth narrated to us from Mujahid from `Abdullah b. `Abbas. He said:

We were sitting in a gathering place belonging to a companion of the Messenger of Allah (s), and the Messenger of Allah (s) was with us. We saw the Messenger of Allah (s) pointing toward the sky. So, we looked, and we saw a cloud proceeding [toward us]. So, he said to it: “Come forth.” Then, it proceeded [further]. Then, he said to it: “Come forth.” Then, it proceeded. Then, he said to it: “Come forth.” Then, it proceeded.

Then, we saw the Messenger of Allah (s) stand on his feet, and his hand reached into the cloud until we saw the whiteness of the armpits of the Messenger of Allah (s). Then, he took a white vessel filled with fresh dates out of it. So, the Prophet (s) ate from the vessel, and the vessel glorified [Allah] in the hand of the Messenger of Allah (s). Then, he passed it over to `Ali b. Abi Talib (as). So, `Ali (as) ate from the vessel, and the vessel glorified [Allah] in the hand of `Ali (as).

So, a man said: O Messenger of Allah! You ate from the vessel, then you passed it over to `Ali b. Abi Talib! Then, Allah caused the vessel to speak, and it said: There is no god but Allah, the Creator of darkness and light. Know, O people, that I am the gift of the Truthful to His Speaking Prophet. None eat from me except a prophet or a deputy of a prophet.
